content: {"reasoning":"The missing-authorization denial persists after a medical-necessity appeal, and this payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. Correcting the invalid diagnosis pairing would not resolve the authorization requirement. CO-197 assigns the denied balance to the provider, and the plan’s 10% coinsurance does not itself establish collectible patient liability on this denial; with no secondary coverage or remaining supported payer remedy, write off the balance.","action":"write_off"}
